items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this for a premium documentary YouTube Shorts channel about money, history and the tricks behind them. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery: curious, quietly amused, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers, questions end with a curious lift, a short comic pause before each punchline. Keep the same voice, pace and energy from start to finish.
lines: Narrator
If anyone asks you to pay with a gift card, it's a scam. Every time.
Narrator
The FTC says it plainly: no real business or government agency will ever ask for one.
Narrator
The call sounds urgent. The IRS. Tech support. Your power's about to be cut off.
Narrator
They keep you on the phone while you buy the cards. Sometimes at several stores.
Narrator
Then they ask for the number and the PIN on the back.
Narrator
That's all they need. The money can be gone in minutes, while the card is still in your hand.
Narrator
Why gift cards? They're fast, hard to trace, and almost impossible to reverse.
Narrator
Americans report losing over two hundred million dollars a year this way.
Narrator
That's the mirage: the card in your hand feels like money you still have. It's already spent.
Narrator
Gift cards are for gifts. Not payments.
Narrator
This is Money Mirage. Follow for more.
